newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: NWE oil products dip, except steady fuel oil.
newsitem.headline: NWE oil products dip, except steady fuel oil.

text.p: NWE oil products dipped on Wednesday morning in response to futures weakness, with the exception of fuel oil which held at Tuesday's closing levels, dealers said.
Gasoline barges were $1 a tonne down. One eurograde barge traded at $191 fob AR. Offers for Rotterdam running refinery material were at $193 fob.

Heating oil barges lost $2 a tonne as weak U.S. stocks figures pushed down IPE futures. Offers for prompt product held at IPE May +$1 fob Rotterdam or +75 cents fob Amsterdam. Amsterdam sellers were more in evidence than their Rotterdam counterparts.
High sulphur fuel oil barges were consistently offered at $83 fob ARA. Bids were initially at $80, but rose through the morning to $82, as on Tuesday. One barge traded at $82.50.
Some traders said buyers were more eager as bunker demand improved. Others said bunker demand was low, under 10,000 tonnes, and the strength was due to trading plays.
